Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I am relieved ! Ouf. It makes me happy that you are not so crédule like some.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: There is a few, the same ones who dislike my Frenchness, who are targeting me with pranks and diffamation. I apparemment seem like un stéréotype of some kind.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: The annoying Français, is what I mean. I have been told that my clothing is not helping.

Line.Text: L'arbre you talked to is probablement one of those. I would be careful about listening to him too much, or you will also get l'impression that there is little to me except being odieux.

Choices.Text: Do you know who that Kweebec is, then?
